say:2:1820117001:1.text: You look even more adorable than before, my darling! Come here and let me get a good look at you!
say:2:1820117001:1.source_cn: 我亲爱的薇薇娅，你比之前更可爱了！来来来，快让姨妈看看！

say:3:1820117002:1.source_cn: 莎、莎柏琳姨妈？你比我想得要更……

say:5:1820117004:0.text: Bet you didn't know—we Graveborn keep the appearance we had at the moment of death, forever. We never age!
say:5:1820117004:0.source_cn: 你们还不知道，亡灵的外表会永远保持着死亡时的年纪，不会...

say:6:1820117005:0.text: Now, Vivi, tell me—did you sneak your way here, or did you actually die?
say:6:1820117005:0.source_cn: 好了，先不说这个。薇薇娅，你先告诉我——你究竟是偷渡来...

say:7:1820117006:0.text: Relax, I'm still alive! I snuck in on a ship. This whole Graveborn look is just magic!
say:7:1820117006:0.source_cn: 姨妈，你放心吧，我是跟着船队一起过来的，没有真的死！这...

say:8:1820117007:1.text: Um... that's just me, though. My friend here just became a Graveborn.
say:8:1820117007:1.source_cn: 呃……不过，我身边这位朋友倒是真的刚死。

say:9:1820117008:1.text: Ah, I see. Congratulations on your recent passing, my dear!
say:9:1820117008:1.source_cn: 原来是这样。亲爱的，恭喜新死！
say:9:1820117008:1.male: Ah, I see. Congratulations on your recent passing, my dear!
say:9:1820117008:1.female: Ah, I see. Congratulations on your recent passing, my dear!

say:10:1820117009:1.text: It might take a while to get used to life here, but trust me, Novaris beats the world of the living!
say:10:1820117009:1.source_cn: 一开始可能会有些不习惯。但放心吧，诺珐斯是个很好的地方...
say:10:1820117009:1.male: It might take a while to get used to life here, but trust me, Novaris beats the world of the living!
say:10:1820117009:1.female: It might take a while to get used to life here, but trust me, Novaris beats the world of the living!

choice_prompt:11:1820117009.text: It might take a while to get used to life here, but trust me, Novaris beats the world of the living!
choice_prompt:11:1820117009.source_cn: 一开始可能会有些不习惯。但放心吧，诺珐斯是个很好的地方。在这里，死了绝对比活着更快活！
choice_prompt:11:1820117009.male: It might take a while to get used to life here, but trust me, Novaris beats the world of the living!
choice_prompt:11:1820117009.female: It might take a while to get used to life here, but trust me, Novaris beats the world of the living!

say:12:1820117010:1.text: ... Oh, right! Speaking of which, who is this party for, Aunt Sabrine? I don't remember today being your death anniversary.
say:12:1820117010:1.source_cn: ……对了！说起来，姨妈，这里的忌日派对到底是怎么回事？...

say:13:1820117011:1.text: Today's celebration is for my new husband and our son.
say:13:1820117011:1.source_cn: 因为今天派对的主角不是我，而是我的新婚丈夫和儿子哦。

say:14:1820117012:1.text: They happened to pass away on the same day, so we decided to throw one big party for them both!
say:14:1820117012:1.source_cn: 他们两个的忌日恰巧是同一天呢，所以我们决定办一个隆重的...

say:15:1820117013:1.text: ... Hold on, your husband... and son?

say:16:1820117014:1.text: Aunt Sabrine, I thought you said marriage wasn't your thing!
say:16:1820117014:1.source_cn: 姨妈，你不是不愿意结婚吗？怎么死后不仅结了婚……还生了...

say:17:1820117015:1.text: My dear Vivi, don't be so surprised!
say:17:1820117015:1.source_cn: 薇薇娅，我亲爱的！不要这么惊讶。

say:18:1820117016:0.text: I said that back then mainly because I was sick... and hadn't met the right person yet.
say:18:1820117016:0.source_cn: 我生前不愿意结婚，主要是因为我的病，以及还没遇到合适的人。

say:19:1820117017:1.text: Now that I have endless time ahead of me, I'm ready to enjoy life and build a family with the man I love.
say:19:1820117017:1.source_cn: 死后，我有很长的时间来享受生活，以及做好和喜欢的人组建...

say:20:1820117018:1.text: Graveborn, of course, can't have children.
say:20:1820117018:1.source_cn: 至于我的儿子艾维斯……呵呵，亲爱的薇薇娅，亡灵当然是没...

say:21:1820117019:1.text: My husband and I adopted Elvens after an accident took his life. It's a common practice here in Novaris.
say:21:1820117019:1.source_cn: 艾维斯是我和丈夫一起领养来的，是一个在孩童时就意外死去...

say:23:1820117021:1.text: Vivi tries her best to look unfazed, but beneath it, you can tell she is struggling to make sense of the Graveborn life.
say:23:1820117021:1.source_cn: 尽管薇薇娅竭力想表现出轻松的表情，但你看得出，她仍然无...
say:23:1820117021:1.male: Vivi tries her best to look unfazed, but beneath it, you can tell she is struggling to make sense of the Graveborn life.
say:23:1820117021:1.female: Vivi tries her best to look unfazed, but beneath it, you can tell she is struggling to make sense of the Graveborn life.

say:24:1820117022:1.text: Sabrine could see that as well.
say:24:1820117022:1.source_cn: 很明显，莎柏琳也看出了这一点。
say:24:1820117022:1.male: Sabrine could see that as well.
say:24:1820117022:1.female: Sabrine could see that as well.

say:25:1820117023:1.text: The party won't start until later. Why don't I show you around the city in the meantime?
say:25:1820117023:1.source_cn: 距离派对开始还要一点时间呢，不如我带你们在城里四处逛逛吧？

say:26:1820117024:1.text: I have to show you what my life is like here, Vivi!
say:26:1820117024:1.source_cn: 一方面，是让我们的小薇薇娅能安心点——

say:27:1820117025:1.text: And for you, my freshie friend, I don't mind showing you the ropes!
say:27:1820117025:1.source_cn: 另一方面，也让这位新亡的朋友熟悉、适应一下这里。
say:27:1820117025:1.male: And for you, my freshie friend, I don't mind showing you the ropes!
say:27:1820117025:1.female: And for you, my freshie friend, I don't mind showing you the ropes!

say:28:1820117026:1.text: Let's check out the market here!
say:28:1820117026:1.source_cn: 那……我想去一趟这里的集市！

say:29:1820117027:1.text: A death anniversary party... It's basically like a birthday party, right?
say:29:1820117027:1.source_cn: 虽然我还不太理解忌日派对……但这肯定是和生日派对一样，...

say:30:1820117028:1.text: It's bad form to show up to a party empty-handed! Hopefully, I'll find a nice gift at the market.
say:30:1820117028:1.source_cn: 既然要参加派对，就不能空手来！我想去集市看看有没有合适...

say:31:1820117029:1.text: Oh, Vivi... You're always so sweet!
say:31:1820117029:1.source_cn: 我可爱的小薇薇娅……你还是那么贴心！

say:32:1820117030:1.text: There's a market nearby with stalls selling all sorts of fun little knickknacks. We can head there!
say:32:1820117030:1.source_cn: 这附近有一处集市，里面经常会卖些新奇有趣的小玩意。我们...

choice:11:1:2.text: I can tell you're having a great time here.
choice:11:1:2.male: I can tell you're having a great time here.
choice:11:1:2.female: I can tell you're having a great time here.

choice:11:2:3.text: A death anniversary party? Well, that's new.
choice:11:2:3.source_cn: 你们甚至在办忌日派对
choice:11:2:3.male: A death anniversary party? Well, that's new.
choice:11:2:3.female: A death anniversary party? Well, that's new.
